name: grub
title: Material GRUB theme
summary: Material You boot menu theme for GRUB

commands.apply: render the theme again and install it (after a change of scheme, style or seed)
commands.doctor: check the install and say what is wrong
commands.preview: render the menu to a picture without installing
commands.ventoy: put the theme on a Ventoy stick

menu: Render the theme again and install it

options.name: mode
options.summary: Ventoy stick mode: dynamic or snapshot

options.name: ventoy
options.summary: install on the Ventoy stick mounted at this path

options.name: stage-only
options.summary: build the theme and stop before GRUB is touched

options.name: pkg
options.summary: install an already built theme directory

options.name: dist-out
options.summary: copy the built theme to this directory (with stage-only)

questions.title: Screen resolution
questions.help: GRUB draws on the screen the firmware picks, usually your main monitor: choose that monitor's own resolution. Automatic reads it from your system. Any other size gets a theme written for exactly that size.

options.label: Detected automatically
options.help: Recommended: the installer reads your display's size.

questions.title: Raw entry name line
questions.help: The small muted line at the bottom with the entry title exactly as GRUB sees it. Useful when something looks wrong.

questions.title: Countdown bar
questions.help: The 'Booting in N seconds' bar and label.

questions.title: Timeout in seconds
questions.help: Seconds before the default entry boots. Leave empty to keep GRUB's own timeout (5 by default).
